preconditions.description: Input integers u and v are non-negative.
Input integers u and v do not exceed 10^18.

postconditions.description: If no valid array exists, the output is exactly '-1'.

postconditions.expression: not no_solution and (len(arr) == 0 and u == 0 and v == 0)
postconditions.description: If a solution exists and u=v=0, the array is empty (length 0).

postconditions.expression: not no_solution and len(arr) > 0 and all(x > 0 for x in arr) and sum(arr) == v and eval(' ^ '.join(map(str, arr))) == u
postconditions.description: If a solution exists and is non-empty, all elements are positive integers, their sum equals v, and their bitwise XOR equals u.

postconditions.expression: not no_solution and (len(arr) == 1 or len(arr) == 2 or len(arr) == 3)
postconditions.description: The length of the array is minimal, which is at most 3 for any valid pair (u, v).
